Below the logo, there is a shield-shaped graphic with the text "KILLS 99.99% ILLNESS CAUSING GERMS" and a plus sign, indicating its effectiveness against germs. The label also includes the text "BE 100% SURE GERM DEFENCE ANTISEPTIC
